rationale.claim: Literal uniqueness among nonnegative equilibria is false by the credited alternating2/0 matching on the unit-rate line. The published alternative proof concerns unique strictly positive equilibrium and simultaneous almost-sure coordinatewise homogenization: countable undirected simple bounded-degree graphs, positive bounded-above rates without a common positive lower bound,0<=alpha<1, arbitrary finite deterministic positive integer initial edge counts without a common bound.
rationale.identity: The original30005453/OWR-12697708-006 question is explicitly corrected rather than silently equated with unrestricted nonnegative uniqueness. Qin2610.11780v1 Theorem1.1 already gives the full positive theorem with broader real initialization; that prior result is prominently credited in PDF, source, description, ledger and PR.
rationale.limits: No new-theorem, first/sole-proof, spatially uniform convergence, real-initialization extension, zero-edge or critical-alpha claim.
